name: piolab-asm
description: Syntax highlighting for the ISA packs' assembly and a step debugger for their engine models

piolab.adapterCommand.description: Command that starts the debug adapter (give an absolute path if uv is not on the PATH VS Code sees, e.g. ~/.local/bin/uv).

program.description: Program source (any ISA pack's suffix) or image JSON to run on its engine model.

scenario.description: Instead of program: a scenario name in the ISA pack's scenarios module (e.g. uart_rx), or module:function.

devices.description: Bus partners attached to the program's pins, as piolab --device specs: uart[:baud=N,send=0x55,0x41,ppm=N,bits=N,parity=none|even|odd,stop=N], spi[:mode=N], i2c[:addr=N,stretch=N]. Defaults: [tool.piolab.devices].

hostTx.description: Words the host pushes into the TX FIFO, e.g. ["0x41", "0x42"].

model.description: The ISA pack's engine model to run (piolab models; default: [tool.piolab] model, else the pack's default).

cycles.description: Maximum sysclk cycles to run (default: [tool.piolab] cycles, else 100000).

dut.description: Instead of model: engine (default), stub, tt_template or package.module:callable, e.g. an Engine subclass with more cores. Threads, scopes and VCD groups follow the model.

vcd.description: VCD file rewritten with the waveform so far (bench nets + engine probes) at every stop; open it in GTKWave or Surfer and reload.

trace.description: Print every engine and bench event in the Debug Console while running.

cwd.description: The PIOLab project directory (holding pyproject.toml). Default: found from the program's path.
